Read-only; nothing built or run. Card #29771 (app root landing across areas; menu-only empty state), the out-of-scope finding of #29678.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The widening is the two `empty.*` locale keys, present in all ten packs** (`appOpensFromMenu`, `appOpensFromMenuDescription`; each `+` line counted ten times; en carries one comment line more). On the #28552 reading, `TranslationKeys` widens with them, which is what the amendment's `Clause-②: yes` declares.
- **No other published surface moves.** `AppNoAccessEmptyState`'s `reason` union gains `'menu-only'`, but the component is reachable from no package entry (`exports` is `.` and `./styles.css`; `index.ts` does not export it), so the union is internal. `AppContent` is exported as `DefaultAppContent` and its props are untouched; what changes is its behaviour on an app root that used to render an empty `main`, which is the measured defect the card names. `firstRouteAcross` and `findFirstLandingAcross` are module-private.
- **The walk reuses the existing pieces.** `firstRouteAcross` iterates `shownTrees` (already handed to `resolveLandingRoute` by `AppRootLanding`) through the existing `findFirstRoute` with the existing type sets; the declared landing stays first; the fallthrough that returned `null` now draws the empty state with `reason="menu-only"`, and only after `appServesNoNavigation` has been answered false, so `no-navigation` keeps its own path. `electSidebarArea` on `main` elects the area holding the routed entry, so an area landing opens with that area active, as the body says.
- **The `menu-only` branch offers no Setup link** by construction (it returns before the `setupPath` branches) and keeps the shared `data-testid`, with `data-reason` as the discriminator the tests pin. `AppPreview` mirrors the same order over `normalizeNav` of each area's navigation.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Clause-②: yes` (bare = widening), `Metadata-protocol: none` → patch is the level the protocol axis gives. No ADR-0087 marker is needed: nothing retires.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H. CI on `d1b4d8e8` was in progress when this was written (10 success, 11 skipped, 31 in progress, 0 failure). The seat's ACCEPT waits on green.
- `Fixes #29771` closes the card; both options the card offered are taken (areas walked, menu-only state), which the card allowed the reader to decide.
- The changeset body opens with the `Clause-②` line and has no `type(scope): …` title line, so the CHANGELOG bullet will open with the first prose sentence rather than a title. Five pending changesets on `main` already take this form, and the body gates pass on it, so this is a style note, not a finding.
- The moved pin in `AppContent.studioRootLanding-12113.test.tsx` (url-only root: "no empty state" → "menu-only empty state") is the card's own defect being re-pinned; the seat approved it in the card thread per the report.
- The body's "read from source, not measured" note (an app with a visible area draws that area's tree in place of the top-level navigation, so a top-level landing can open with no sidebar entry) is pre-existing `UnifiedSidebar` behaviour; this PR does not change it and the note is honest about that.

### ④ Design judgment

- Walking every shown tree in authored order, with the working-over-doc preference held across trees rather than per tree, is the right generalization of #29678: the question is "what does this app open on", and an app's manual at the top of its navigation should not beat its objects in an area.
- Drawing a reason-specific empty state instead of `null` is the right answer to a blank `main`; reusing `AppNoAccessEmptyState` with its own title, icon and no Setup link keeps one empty-state surface while saying nothing untrue about access.
- Narrowing face: nothing is taken away; every app that landed before lands on the same entry (the top-level tree is still walked first with the same types).

No must-fix. No should-fix.
